نلتفت (form VIII)
# نَلْتَفِتُ (naltafitu) /nal.ta.fi.tu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَفَتَ (iltafata)
# نَلْتَفِتَ (naltafita) /nal.ta.fi.ta/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَفَتَ (iltafata)
# نَلْتَفِتْ (naltafit) /nal.ta.fit/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِلْتَفَتَ (iltafata)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
